name: nodebookmd
title: NodebookMD
description: Search the Houdini documentation offline with NodebookMD and open pages in the app.
author: john_chedeville

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Houdini Docs
commands.subtitle: NodebookMD
commands.description: Search nodes, VEX functions, Python and every other page of the Houdini docs. Type v:, sop: or h: to search one part.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
